_comment: The people of Bytorsskug. Placed in map files with ;npc=x,y <id>. name: given, middle (occupational) and surname (affiliation; may be empty if unknown). dialogue: a file in data/dialogue/ (without .json). wander: how far (in steps) they stray from where they're placed; 0 = they stay put. ALL NAMES AND LINES ARE PLACEHOLDERS (given names come from the name generator).

name: Boda
Trader
supplier.description: Keeps the supplier's shop on the edge of the plaza.

name: Ymaj
Repairer
Tinkerforge
artificer.description: An artificer of the Artificers' Guild, who runs the workshop near the plaza.

name: Erþel
Clerk
Hunters
clerk.description: Keeps the Tower Acquisition Guild's hall in order.

name: Klubo
Porter
porter.description: Carries loads across the plaza for a few shards.

name: Jokro
Washer
washer.description: Fetches water from the well and doesn't hurry about it.

name: Somirk
Carter
carter.description: Drives a cart in from the farms most Pulses.

name: Bumpry
Archer
Hunters
trainer.description: A seasoned Hunter who teaches at the guild hall.

name: Bartum
Smith
smith.description: Works hide, shell, iron and stone into gear, to order.

name: Lifa
Healer
healer.description: Sets bones, stitches cuts and draws out poison, for a fee.

name: Ymalda
Librarian
Academy
librarian.description: Keeps the Academy's library, and buys whatever writing Hunters bring back.

name: Retired
Hunter
mentor.description: A retired Hunter, who teaches what they know for less than the trainer.

name: A
Hunter
rival.description: Another Hunter of the Guild (game/rivals.py fills in who).

name: Palboj
Quartermaster
Hunters
quartermaster.description: The Guild's quartermaster, in the stash room: supplies for Hunters, more of them than the market keeps. (Placeholder; there once the Guild's works hire one.)

name: Etly
Scholar
Hunters
scholar.description: The Guild's scholar of the Wayfinder's words, in the training corner's study. (Placeholder; there once the Guild's works build the study.)

name: Pulnaþ
Trophymaster
trophymaster.description: Keeps the trophy wall in the lodge by the plaza: the heaviest of every creature Hunters have hauled home, and who hauled it. (Placeholder.)

name: Dimam
Butcher
butcher.description: The butcher by the plaza. Breaks down whatever Hunters drag in, and keeps the meat. (Placeholder.)

name: Selda
Fencer
Hunters
selda_hunt.description: An old Hunter, wedged into a cleft in the rock with her sword across her knees. Hurt, and out of light.

name: Selda
Fencer
Hunters
selda.description: Retired now, and not pleased about it. She teaches what the miasma taught her. (Chapter 1.)

name: Nalka
Broker
dealer.description: Deals in houses and land: a house in the city, one out in Ingenfjel, a stead along the Towerway. Sells improvements for them too. (Placeholder.)

name: Erdo
Cartographer
Hunters
cartographer.description: The Guild's cartographer, in his study behind a window off the front hall. He turns Hunters' scouting reports into proper maps. (Placeholder name; there once the Guild's works build the Cartographer's Study.)

name: Toful
Tackleman
Waters
tackleman.description: The tackleman of the Watermen and Anglers' Guild: rods, line, bait and lures, and he buys fish by the weight. His shop is the nearest to the river. (The Guild and the surname Waters are the user's; the name, the shop and every line are placeholders.)
